Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class MulticastClient

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Client
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.MulticastClient
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, Runnable
    public class MulticastClient
extends Client
    Provides a KDC client for sending and receiving agents using multicast communication.

    The client may join one or more multicast groups and send asynchronous agents to those groups. Multicast communication is asynchronous and does not support synchronous agent requests.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    Client, MulticastParameters, MulticastSocketOptions

    • Constructor Detail

      • MulticastClient

        public MulticastClient​(MulticastParameters parameters)
                throws com.kristensoft.kdc.license.runtime.LicenseException,
                       KristenCommsException
        Creates a multicast client using the specified configuration.

        The client initializes its multicast agent queue and, if automatic startup is enabled, creates the multicast socket and starts the client. If latency metrics are enabled, the associated metric accumulators are also started.

        Parameters:
        parameters - the parameters used to configure this multicast client
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if parameters is null
        com.kristensoft.kdc.license.runtime.LicenseException - if the required KDC license cannot be validated
        KristenCommsException - if automatic startup is enabled and the multicast socket cannot be created

      • joinGroup

        public void joinGroup​(InetSocketAddress group)
               throws IOException
        Joins the specified multicast group.

        The group is joined using the network interface associated with the configured bind address when that interface can be resolved.

        Parameters:
        group - the multicast group to join
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if group is null
        IllegalStateException - if the multicast socket has not been created
        IOException - if an error occurs while joining the multicast group

      • leaveGroup

        public void leaveGroup​(InetSocketAddress group)
                throws KristenCommsException
        Leaves the specified multicast group.
        Parameters:
        group - the multicast group to leave
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if group is null
        IllegalStateException - if the multicast socket has not been created
        KristenCommsException - if an error occurs while leaving the multicast group

      • sendAsync

        public void sendAsync​(Agent agent,
                      InetSocketAddress group)
               throws IOException,
                      KristenCommsException
        Sends an agent asynchronously to the specified multicast group.

        The agent is serialized and sent to the specified group without waiting for a reply.

        Parameters:
        agent - the agent to send
        group - the multicast group to which the agent is sent
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if agent or group is null
        IllegalStateException - if the multicast socket has not been created
        IOException - if an error occurs while sending the agent
        KristenCommsException - if an error occurs while serializing the agent
